title: 高山草甸的野花与虹光

prompt._raw_prompt: 英文：Create a panoramic mountain meadow covered in yellow and white wildflowers, with rugged peaks (some dusted with snow) in the background, a dramatic sky with dark storm clouds and a faint rainbow, capturing the contrast between the vibrant flora and the moody sky. 中文：绘制一幅覆盖黄白色野花的高山草甸全景，背景是崎岖的山峰（部分有积雪），天空布满戏剧性的乌云并带有一道微弱的彩虹，捕捉鲜艳植物与 Moody 天空的对比。
